tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a specific Tygart Media article or page by its URL slug (e.g. "the-restoration").

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for one Tygart Media product/offer by name or slug, including its live page content.

slug_or_name.description: Product slug or name, e.g. "restoration-job-tracker-pro" or "Job Tracker Pro"

tools.name: getArticle
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific Tygart Media blog article by its URL slug. Will not return shop product pages - use getProductDetails for those.

tools.name: getProductDetails
tools.description: Get full details for a specific Tygart Media shop product by its URL slug, including description and price. If price is null, tell the user to check the page directly.

tools.name: getPurchaseLink
tools.description: Get the Square checkout link for a specific product so a human can complete payment. This does NOT complete a purchase - it only returns the link. The human must click through and pay on Square themselves.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Tygart Media's purchasable Notion/Claude templates and kits, with price and a short summary.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all blog categories/topics on tygartmedia.com.

tools.name: recommendProduct
tools.description: Recommend Tygart Media products based on the user's role or problem and optional budget. Returns best-fit matches, not an exhaustive list. Price may be null for some results.

need.description: The user's role or problem, e.g. "restoration contractor job tracking" or "delegation for owners"

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Tygart Media blog posts and articles by keyword. Returns matching titles, excerpts, and URLs.

tools.name: searchArticles
tools.description: Search Tygart Media blog articles by keyword. Excludes shop products. Use for questions about AI infrastructure, restoration industry topics, SEO/GEO strategy, or Notion/Claude systems.

tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search Tygart Media shop products (Notion templates, Claude skills, leadership kits) by keyword. Price may be null for some pages - if so, tell the user to check the page directly for current pricing.
